brief:
Jose Andres, founder of World Central Kitchen, said three people killed in an Israeli strike on a food aid vehicle in Gaza were not members of the organization's team, Middle East Eye reported. The strike hit a vehicle delivering humanitarian assistance in the enclave.

Andres did not provide further details about the identities of the three deceased or circumstances surrounding their deaths in the vehicle.

title: World Central Kitchen founder says three Gaza strike victims not staff members
